project_name: KKN-PLP Terintegrasi Angkatan 65 Kelompok 55 Landing Page

typography.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Keep Poppins for a modern, geometric, professional feel. Ensure line-height for headings is tight (leading-none or leading-tight) and tracking is tight.

visual_enhancers.border_radius: rounded-2xl to rounded-3xl for cards to establish a premium Apple-like feel.

motion.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth scroll is MANDATORY. Apply to wrapper.
motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line text stagger using Framer Motion. Text wrapped in overflow-hidden spans, animated from y: 100% to 0%.
motion.hover_micro_interactions: All cards should scale up slightly (scale-105) and lift on Y-axis (-translate-y-2) with a smooth transition (duration-300).
motion.parallax: Use Framer Motion's useScroll and useTransform for subtle background image parallax in Hero and About sections.
motion.particles: Subtle tsParticles background in Hero and Footer for an interactive, premium feel.

layouts_and_grids.bento_grid: Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6 with gap-6. Vary column spans (col-span-2, col-span-3) for visual interest.
layouts_and_grids.spacing: Use p-8 to p-12 for card padding. Use py-24 to py-32 for section spacing to give breathing room.

sections_blueprint.name: Navbar
sections_blueprint.details: Sticky top, glassmorphism surface (never fully transparent). Scroll progress bar (1px gold line) at the bottom edge. Includes Logo, Desktop Nav Links, Theme Toggle, and Mobile Hamburger Menu.

sections_blueprint.name: Hero
sections_blueprint.details: h-screen, relative. Background: Mosque/village image with dark green gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-b from-green-950/70 via-green-900/60 to-slate-950/90). Content: Floating Logos (KKN + Univ), large kinetic text reveal 'KKN-PLP Terintegrasi Angkatan 65 / Kelompok 55', tagline 'Gerakan Eco Masjid melalui sedekah Sampah'. CTA Buttons: Primary (Gold, Jelajahi), Secondary (Glass, Profil). Animated scroll indicator at bottom.

sections_blueprint.name: Tentang KKN
sections_blueprint.details: 2 Columns. Left: Bold Manifesto-style text (Chapter 01). Right: Elegant image card with floating animated counters using React CountUp (Mahasiswa, Sekolah Mitra, Lokasi, Lama Kegiatan).

sections_blueprint.name: Program Kerja
sections_blueprint.details: Bento grid of glass cards. Categories: Pendidikan, Keagamaan, Lingkungan, Eco Masjid, Sedekah Sampah, Digitalisasi, Sosial. Each card has an icon, title, short desc, and category badge. Hover animations required.

sections_blueprint.name: Interactive Timeline
sections_blueprint.details: Vertical line down the center (desktop) or left (mobile). Alternating Framer Motion staggered reveals for nodes: Observasi, Koordinasi, Perencanaan, Pelaksanaan, Evaluasi, Penutupan.

sections_blueprint.name: Masonry Gallery
sections_blueprint.details: Staggered image columns with framer-motion layout animations. Lightbox zoom interaction on click. High-quality imagery.

sections_blueprint.name: Artikel Terbaru
sections_blueprint.details: 3-column grid. Modern cards with thumbnail, date, category badge, title, summary, and 'Baca Selengkapnya' button.

sections_blueprint.name: Lokasi & Map
sections_blueprint.details: Wide Google Maps embed. Overlay a glassmorphism card over the map detailing the address (Kelurahan, Kecamatan, Kabupaten, Provinsi).

sections_blueprint.name: Link Penting (Quick Access Hub)
sections_blueprint.details: Bento Grid of 14 links. Use large Lucide icons. High priority links (Web LP2M, Dashboard, Modul) get col-span-2. Socials get col-span-1. Apply glassmorphism and hover glow.

sections_blueprint.name: Tim KKN
sections_blueprint.details: Grid of portrait cards. Clean minimalist style. Grayscale to color on hover, sliding up social icons.

sections_blueprint.name: FAQ
sections_blueprint.details: Clean modern accordion using Shadcn. No borders, just bottom separators.

sections_blueprint.name: Testimoni & Sponsor
sections_blueprint.details: Testimonial auto-slider (framer-motion or swiper). Below it, a fast-running logo marquee of Sponsors/Mitra in grayscale, color on hover.

sections_blueprint.name: Footer & Kontak
sections_blueprint.details: Huge 'Mari Berkolaborasi' heading. Premium dark footer layout. Address, Email, WhatsApp, Socials, Back to top button.

sections_blueprint.name: Floating Elements
sections_blueprint.details: Floating WhatsApp button bottom right. Dark/Light mode toggle bottom left or in nav. Custom cursor glow effect on desktop.

components_needed: Shadcn Primitives (Accordion, Card, Button, Badge, Dialog for Lightbox)
instructions_to_main_agent: Read this guideline entirely before scaffolding the UI.
Implement the theme toggle using next-themes or standard React context updating the generic 'dark' class on the html element.
Use Framer Motion for ALL entrance animations. Stagger lists and grid items.
Create a realistic data payload for the Team, Articles, and Programs so the page looks complete.
Ensure perfect contrast ratios. Use text-shadow if placing text over the hero image.
Use `.js` or `.jsx` file extensions as the project is not set up with TypeScript based on instructions.
Integrate Lucide React for modern iconography throughout.
Implement the 'Quick Access Hub' accurately with the 14 requested links using a dense bento grid.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Avoid generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical grids where possible to create visual tension.
Never apply global transitions like 'transition: all'. Target specific properties (e.g. transition-transform transition-colors).
All interactive elements and key sections MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute for testing.
Ensure 'prefers-reduced-motion' is respected for heavy animations.
Do not use complete transparent backgrounds in sticky headers; use glassmorphism with a border to separate from content.
Implement micro-animations on all hover states (buttons, cards, links).
Use generous padding (2x to 3x standard) to give components breathing room.
